h: Up Cranbrook Road from the town centre
p: Cranbrook Road heads north out of Ilford town centre, so this MERKUR sits on the edge of the main shopping area, a short walk from the Exchange shopping centre and Ilford station, now on the Elizabeth line, which gets you into central London in no time. It's 18+ only.

Carry on up Cranbrook Road and you'll reach Valentines Park, a big, much-loved East London park with a boating lake, gardens and Valentines Mansion, a Georgian house you can look round. Redbridge Museum, in the Central Library in town, is worth popping into if you like a bit of local history.
